changes_made.explanation: Normalized model names by removing specific version numbers and collapsing ChatGPT references to GPT-3.5. Simplified verbose output descriptions.
Normalized metrics to canonical abbreviations and removed verbose descriptions. The paper uses these automatic metrics (SR, GC, ACC, PLW) specifically for evaluating generated actions and plans.
No LLMs are used as judges/evaluators in this paper. LLMs are used for generation and insight summarization, but not for post-generation evaluation.
No human evaluation is conducted in this paper. All evaluation is done through automatic metrics on benchmark tasks.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on embodied AI agents and their planning/decision-making capabilities, using NLG techniques primarily for code generation (Python scripts) and insight summarization. The evaluation uses standard embodied AI metrics rather than traditional NLG metrics like BLEU/ROUGE. The paper uses LLMs for generation but not as judges/evaluators.
